comparison.objective: Select and stack shims to achieve a target height, versus tune a damper from observed impacts.
comparison.physical_skill: Discrete part selection and flat stacking versus recessed-tool manipulation, continuous collar adjustment, locking, and repeated cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Reach 80±2 mm with the fewest shims; candidate must satisfy dynamic travel, energy, velocity, rebound, locking, and drift constraints.
comparison.reason: Both involve adjustment, but shim selection is static geometric fit-up; the candidate is continuous, tool-mediated dynamic commissioning.
